levels.name: Stable
levels.promise: Covered by the compatibility and deprecation policy. Definitions, API fields, CLI flags and behavior change only through announced deprecation.

levels.name: Beta
levels.promise: Feature complete and tested end to end. From the first beta release, breaking changes go through deprecation; these features become stable with the first stable release.

levels.name: Experimental
levels.promise: Opt-in and may change or be removed in any release without deprecation. Use it to evaluate, not to depend on.
